angle_tolerance_deg.rationale: screening window wider than any fit's angular sigma.

equal_radius_tolerance.rationale: screening window for radii that might be one parameter.

frame_margin.rationale: 10% of the winning score separates two datum candidates.

eigengap_min.rationale: half a percent of the spectrum pins one motion.

pitch_epsilon.rationale: two percent of extent per radian.

translation_epsilon.rationale: a twentieth of the unit six-vector.

offset_tolerance.rationale: screening window in mm for axis offsets at this part size.

sigma_multiple.rationale: three sigma: beyond it is not explained by fit noise.

tangent_tolerance.rationale: screening window for tangency on a part of this size.
